name: @vedmoulya/world-model
description: VedMoulya World Model & Business Operating System (SPRINT-032) — a narrow COMPOSITION layer that represents the minimum useful world for better user decisions: a bounded owner-scoped typed graph over EXISTING entities (user/work/goals/opportunities/capabilities/providers/outcomes), configurable business units, evidence-only opportunity economics, a provider-neutral AI workforce role abstraction, a generic bounded workflow factory and an honest external-world signal interface. NOT an engine: no discovery, no provider selection, no approval, no spending, no execution, no memory promotion — every authority stays in the frozen estate and is reached through narrow ports.
